basic_info.description: Welcome to the home that works as hard as you do! This fully detached, tastefully remodeled gem has a secret superpower - Duplex Zoning! Use it as a spacious single family home, or easily transform it into two separate units with just the addition of a door. Upstairs you'll find 2 bright beds and a stylish bath. Downstairs offers 1 bed, 1 bath and flex space, perfect for guests, a home office, or even a rental. Enjoy the generously sized yard, ideal for BBQs, gardening, or simply soaking up the sun. Love to explore? You're just a short stroll to local favorites like Golden Island Cafe and Henry's Coffee, plus convenient access to tech shuttles, Stonestown, and freeways. Don't miss this rare opportunity to live smart, earn more, and enjoy it all. Secure this beautiful home and step into a whole new world of possibilities!
